caption: Studies are ordered by role in the evidence synthesis: comparative cohorts that contribute to the pooled continue-versus-hold analyses first (infection or wound complications, then disease flare), then proportion and single-arm cohorts, then narrative cohorts, and finally the case series and case reports. All values are as reported in the source article; NR denotes not reported. Where a study reports the same diagnosis against two denominators, both are stated. Berthold 2013 and Borgas 2020 share an overlapping Lund and Skane arthroplasty population and never enter the same pool, under the pre-specified overlap rule. The consolidated main-text version of this table is Table 1.
